label: SIMULATED: synthetic riser and clogs (WNTR 1.5.0), REAL HSB Living Lab demand (CC BY 4.0)

design.unit_of_evaluation: scenario = one building-week with one clog state (7 nightly tests)

train.building: train map (seed 101): 28 HSB apartments assigned to the tower's units

test.building: test map (seed 202): the same 28 HSB apartments reassigned to units, same simulated riser geometry

design.commissioning: one clean week per building, earlier than all its scenario weeks
design.threshold: 95th percentile of out-of-fold P(clog) or max-z on clean training nights (GroupKFold by week)
design.ci: 95% two-stage cluster bootstrap (1000 resamples): the 8 test demand weeks with replacement, then scenarios within each drawn week (within true severity for macro-F1)

baselines_macro_f1.unit: test nights; training class frequencies from training nights
